rules.name: VENUE_AT_MOST_ONE
rules.description: One venue hosts at most its slot capacity of teams per time slot (capacity comes from the payload, default 1)

rules.name: COACH_NO_OVERLAP
rules.description: One coach coaches at most one team per time slot, EXCEPT in the same venue (D-14: a coach can watch two groups side by side; different venues remain impossible)

rules.name: COACH_PLAYER_NO_OVERLAP
rules.description: A coach-player cannot be in two roles simultaneously

rules.name: TEAM_NO_OVERLAP
rules.description: A team cannot have two sessions at the same time

rules.name: MIN_SESSIONS
rules.description: Each team TARGETS its effective minimum sessions (soft objective bonus, not a hard floor - ENG-18)
